Customers in this segment require higher sensitivity

sophistication from insurance providers, necessitating

Solutions
Behaviour Shifts
Methodology
Outcomes
Encourage consistently exhibited payment behavior through automated
reminders and prompts.
Connect premiums strongly to life goals, incentivizing customers with
rewards and benefits aligned with their aspirations.
Reinforce the concept of delayed gratification at each premium payment
moment, highlighting the long-term benefits of consistent payments.
Provide proactive extensions on due dates, demonstrating immediate
flexibility and understanding of customers' needs.
Show progress towards goal achievement and acknowledge sustained
persistency, prompting customers when they are most receptive to
behavior change.
